method: Mean of two pre-normalization fusion logits: identical seven components retained at1/8 each, ArcIris red/CLAHE score z-values averaged into remaining1/8. Fixed equal views of one original photo; no query label selection or weight search.
scope: Repeated development validation, supplied side16 candidates, all482queries and4 failures; same-side15impostors, FMR<=1%; external pretraining population unknown
